title: Fairness via Explanation Quality: Evaluating Disparities in the Quality of Post hoc Explanations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluates disparities in the quality of post-hoc machine learning explanations across demographic subgroups defined by sex and race.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
